news.title: Delta CEO Predicts Multiple Airline Mergers, Says They’ll All Benefit Delta - One Mile at a Time
news.zh: 達美航空執行長預測多起航空公司併購，並稱這些併購將對達美有利
news.impact: 航空業併購預期增加，達美航空競爭格局將改變

news.title: OpenAI Pauses Stargate UK Data Center Citing Energy Costs - Bloomberg.com
news.zh: OpenAI因能源成本暫停星門英國數據中心計畫
news.impact: 能源成本上升阻礙AI基礎設施擴展，科技業成本壓力加大

news.title: Oil Prices Rise To $100 Per Barrel As Stocks Slow On Doubts About The U.S.-Iran Ceasefire - HuffPost
news.zh: 油價上漲至每桶100美元，美股因美伊停火協議疑慮而下跌
news.impact: 油價飆升推高能源成本，經濟衰退風險和通脹壓力增加

news.title: New Labor Department Rule is Trump’s Latest Favor to the Crypto Industry - Talking Points Memo
news.zh: 勞工部新規則是川普政府對加密貨幣產業的最新優惠
news.impact: 加密貨幣監管放寬，產業獲利好轉，市場風險增加

news.title: Treasury Proposes Rule to Implement the GENIUS Act’s Requirements to Counter Illicit Finance - U.S. Department of the Treasury (.gov)
news.zh: 財政部提議規則以實施天才法案的要求來打擊非法融資
news.impact: 金融監管強化，反洗錢合規成本增加，市場風險控制改善

news.title: The Trump administration just gave a surprise lift to Medicare starting next year. Here’s how it could impact your budget - AOL.com
news.zh: 川普政府為明年推出令人驚喜的醫療保險提升，將影響您的預算
news.impact: 醫療保險政策改革，民眾醫療支出減少，醫療產業營收受影響

news.title: Nexstar asks states, including Colorado, for $150M bond to cover damages from order slowing merger with Tegna - The Colorado Sun
news.zh: 下一星傳媒要求科羅拉多州等地發行1.5億美元債券以賠償延誤與Tegna合併的損失
news.impact: 重大併購受阻產生法律賠償，下一星傳媒財務壓力增加

news.title: ClearBridge Large Cap Growth Strategy Exited Salesforce (CRM) Due to Slowing Growth
news.zh: ClearBridge大型股票成長策略因銷售增長放緩而退出Salesforce
news.impact: Salesforce投資評級下調，股價面臨下行壓力

news.title: Inflation goes up by a whopping monthly rate of nearly 1%—and it’s hitting you at the grocery store and gas station
news.zh: 通脹月率大幅上升近1%，打擊雜貨店和加油站消費
news.impact: 通脹加劇消費支出增加，央行政策調整壓力增加

news.title: OpenAI Freezes UK AI Data Center Plans Over Power Prices, Red Tape
news.zh: OpenAI因電力價格和繁文縟節凍結英國AI數據中心計畫
news.impact: 能源成本和政策障礙延遲AI基礎建設，英國產業競爭力下降
